title: Paloma Business Contract Terms Schedule: Commitment, Refund Window and Upgrade Proration
content:
Four contract figures differ by Paloma Business plan: the calendar days after the first paid subscription charge within which an owner who closes the account gets that charge refunded (0 means none); the months from KYB approval during which the plan is committed (0 means none); the number of monthly fees charged when the account is closed or downgraded below the plan inside the commitment; and whether leaving the plan for a higher one credits the unused part of its current-period fee.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Subscription refund window (calendar days after the first paid subscription charge) | 0, none | 14 | 14 | 14 | 30 | 30 |
| Minimum commitment (months from KYB approval) | 0, none | 0, none | 0, none | 0, none | 12 | 12 |
| Early-termination months (monthly fees charged inside the commitment) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 3 |
| Upgrade proration on leaving the plan for a higher one | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Notes

1. Only Paloma Business Scale and Paloma Business Enterprise carry a minimum commitment, of 12 months, and only those plans carry early-termination months, 3 each.
2. Paloma Business Starter has no subscription refund window and does not credit the unused part of its fee when the account moves to a higher plan.
3. Each figure is read from the column of the plan concerned: the commitment and early-termination months from the committed plan, the proration row from the plan being left.
